loadouts.strength: Explosive anti-armor + thermite for heavy demolitions. Sentries provide sustained cover fire.
loadouts.weakness: Eruptor is slow-firing with a long reload; vulnerable in close quarters.
loadouts.notes: First saved Helldivers build. Factory destruction focus — Eruptor + Thermite for structures, sentries hold the line.

loadouts.strength: Laser cannon = hitscan anti-Stingray + swarm melt (infinite ammo). Sentries watch the skies and cover the swarms.
loadouts.weakness: Trident + laser cannon leaves anti-tank thin; Thermite is the only heavy answer. No long-range heavy punch beyond the cannon.
loadouts.notes: Illuminate warfront. Crossbow struggled vs Stingray strafing jets — swapped to hitscan laser loadout for air + swarm double duty. HIGHER-LEVEL missions (with Vanito): keep Supply Pack to feed the laser beam. On level 5 or below: swap Supply Pack → Guard Dog (Laser) for extra auto-cover, since lower missions don't drain the beam as hard.
